 For the Petitioner/s : Mr. Dilip Kumar Roy, Advocate  For the Opposite Party/s : Mr. Jharkhandi Upadhyay, APP  ======================================================
 CORAM: HONOURABLE MR. JUSTICE SANDEEP KUMAR  ORAL ORDER 2 10-07-2024 Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.
2. Let the defect(s), if any, be removed within a period of four weeks from today.

3. The petitioner seeks bail in connection with Tajpur P.S. Case No. 684 of 2022 registered for the offence under Sections 341, 323, 498A, 379, 504/34 of the IPC and Section  of the D.P. Act.
4.
As per the prosecution story, the complainant was tortured to demand of dowry.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
5. Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that the petitioner is in custody since 19.03.2024 and the petitioner has not demanded any dowry from the opposite party no.2.
6.
Learned A.P.P. has vehemently opposed the prayer for bail.
7. Considering the aforesaid facts, this application for regular bail is allowed.

8. Let the petitioner, above named, be released on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs. 10,000/- (Ten Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate I, Samastipur in connection with Tajpur P.S. Case No. 684 of 2022.
(Sandeep Kumar, J) Guddu/-
